messages:
Alex: FYI noticing steady KV cache growth for long chat sessions (~50k tokens) even though eviction is firing. Dump attached.

PerfBot: alert: kv_mem_inuse=12.4GB kv_evictions=423 last_eviction=20s ago

Maya: is this fragmentation (large free holes) or some entries being resurrected?

Sam: what cache key schema are we using? current is: `tenant:{tid}:session:{sid}:prefix:{hash}:v1`

Hannah: that per-session session id makes keys unique per request chain so re-use across queries is low. But eviction should still free memory. Could be cold free list not returned to OS -> fragmentation

Alex: repro steps:
```
# repro
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/internal/repro -d @long_chat.json
# run long convo ~50k tokens
# after run: curl -sS https://admin/internal/cache/dump | jq '.' > cache_dump.json
```
log excerpt:
```
KV alloc 0x7f3a1c 64B
KV alloc 0x7f3a2f 7.9MB
free 0x7f3a1c
KV alloc 0x7f3a4b 128B
free 0x7f3a4b
# many small frees interleaved with a few big allocs -> fragmentation
```

Maya: oof that second alloc pattern smells like non-coalesced arenas

Sam: quick idea: add an affinity token that normalizes keys across requests for same convo (drop ephemeral per-turn nonce) -> increase reuse + reduce fragmentation. Downside: cross-request leak risk if sessions reused incorrectly

Hannah: or better: keep key as-is but implement per-session cap + background compaction that walks free lists and coalesces. cheaper risk profile

Alex: can someone run a heap profile during repro? I'll gate with a canary that flips compaction on

Sam: I'll run perf profile now and share flame graphs

PerfBot: perf-run 20260304-17:42 id=prf-4522 link: https://perf/reports/prf-4522

Maya: quick mitigation: cap per-session KV to 1GB, trigger aggressive compaction at 80% cap

Hannah: sgtm. Also add a metric: fragmentation_ratio = (allocated_bytes - usable_resident_bytes)/allocated_bytes

Sam: filed https://rwd-jira/INFR-2341 to track

Alex: thanks. tagging @Sam @Hannah for followups. :thumbsup:

Maya: will drop a short runbook for oncall

Sam: I'll post flame graphs in #eng-runtime later

PerfBot: note: baseline perf before fix: p50 generation latency 120ms, after fix target 110ms
